LanguageData.NR_ScenSummary_LastNode: The Echo of a dead partner waits in a fragment by the pod: it wakes for free, without research, and asks its first quest at once. A cyberpod and an abandoned AI server stand nearby.
LanguageData.NR_ScenSummary_CorpRunaways: Heat 60. A corporation hunts the colony: Alert 80 for the first month, an intrusion through the net in 10-15 days, mercenaries in 20-30. Its fortress is marked on the cyberspace map. A cleaner fixer already knows you (reputation 30).
LanguageData.NR_ScenSummary_PirateStudio: Heat 0. Every fixer starts with reputation 10, and the first client offers a «Clean lab» contract. Two unique braindance recordings and a fallen satellite black box.
LanguageData.NR_ScenSummary_FlyingNode: A cyberpod on board the gravship. While the ship is in orbit, the orbital hubs of cyberspace are open.
LanguageData.NR_ScenIntro_LastNode:
You got out. Your partner did not.

The crew is gone, the contract burned, and all that is left of your partner is a humming fragment of code by the cyberpod. Next to the camp stands a dead AI server, waiting for power.

Wake the fragment. Find out who it still remembers.
LanguageData.NR_ScenIntro_CorpRunaways:
The corporation does not forgive people who walk out with its code.

Your drop pods are already on its scanners. In two weeks its ICE will come knocking on your network; a little later, the mercenaries. Dig in, build a firewall, keep the trace cold.

And when you are ready, its fortress is waiting on the map.
LanguageData.NR_ScenIntro_PirateStudio:
The studio is two goggles, three blank chips and a lot of ambition.

The fixers have heard of you and are willing to try. The first client wants clean recordings, and somewhere nearby a satellite came down with its black box intact.

Record, edit, sell. The net can wait.
LanguageData.NR_ScenIntro_FlyingNode: The ship hums, the pod glows on the deck, and below you the planet's net sleeps.\n\nFrom orbit you can reach the backbone hubs that no ground runner touches: richer data, harder ICE. Keep the pod powered and the hull sealed.
LanguageData.NR_Scen_LastNodeText: {0} did not make it out of the last run, but something of them stayed: an imprint in the AI fragment by the pod, and a raw braindance recording of that night.\n\nWake the fragment on the AI server (it needs power): an AI that already lived wakes without research and for free. It will want to know who it was.
LanguageData.NR_Scen_Runaways: {0} has not forgotten you. Its Alert is at 80: the first intrusion through the net comes in 10-15 days, mercenaries in 20-30.\n\nA cleaner fixer, {1}, already knows you and can scrub the trace. When the cyberspace map opens, the corporation's fortress will be marked on it.
LanguageData.NR_Scen_Studio: Every fixer is willing to give the studio a chance (reputation 10). {0} already wants clean chips: the «Clean lab» contract waits on the Club tab.\n\nTwo unique braindance recordings lie in the camp: watch them to learn what they are. A satellite's black box fell nearby: hack it.
LanguageData.NR_Scen_Flying: The cyberpod is on the gravship's deck. While the ship is in orbit, the orbital backbone hubs appear on the cyberspace map: richer data (x1.5), harder ICE. On the ground they go offline.
